ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-2,
Residential Single Unit (Detached House) and B3-2, Community Shopping District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-G in the area bound by:

a line 241 feet south of and parallel to West 69"" Street; the alley next west of and
parallel to South Ashland Avenue; West 71%! Street; and South Ashland Avenue,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Noe

David H. Moore
Alderman, 17 Ward

Common Address:
6925 — 7059 S. Ashland Avenue
